run_challenge_submission: run the make_challenge_submission_file script with --path and --out-path to create a NeurIPS 2021 Open Catalyst Challenge submission file
run_is2re_relaxations: run the make_challenge_submission_file script with --is2re-relaxations to write IS2RE results from trajectory files
run_hybrid_is2re: run the make_challenge_submission_file script with --is2re-relaxations and --hybrid to write IS2RE results from S2EF prediction files
create_submission_from_predictions: create a challenge submission NPZ file from prediction results using the write_predictions function
create_is2re_submission: create an IS2RE challenge submission file from trajectory files using the write_is2re_relaxations function
